title: DebiasPI: Inference-time Debiasing by Prompt Iteration of a Text-to-Image Generative Model
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'ethical intervention prompting' and 'debiasing' generative models to improve fairness. It was presented at a workshop specifically dedicated to 'Fairness and ethics towards transparent AI,' and its core methodology revolves around implementing ethical constraints to ensure diverse and equitable representation in AI-generated content.
